clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies based on gold content: a) Grades of fine gold and standard gold used for manufacture of bullion and coins, and b) Grades of gold alloy used in manufacture of jewellery/artefacts. 1.2 This standard also specifies the guidelines for marking of purity and other details on tested bullion, coins andjewellery/artefacts. NOTE — Artefacts cover medallions andutensils.
